## What will fight you

The rocker-arm support is modelled as a cast iron casting with 6.35 mm shell walls and R12.7-relieved internal corners; cutting it from bar is a benign substitution. Its four foot holes are 1/2-13 UNC-2B through the 6.35 mm foot, with a Ø10.716 mm tap drill (Ø10.72 displayed; 27/64 in). The dimensions and thread class come from `cad/scripts/build_rocker_arm_support.py` and `cad/scripts/_holes.py`.
